meta.title: mpg to L/100km — Convert Miles/Gallon (US) to Liter/100 km |
meta.description: Convert Miles/Gallon (US) (mpg) to Liter/100 km (L/100km) instantly. 1 mpg = 235.21458 L/100km. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert miles/gallon (us)s (mpg) to liter/100 kms (L/100km) instantly. Both measure fuel consumption, so the relationship is strictly linear: each miles/gallon (us) equals 235.21458 liter/100 kms. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One miles/gallon (us) is equal to **235.21458 liter/100 kms**. To go the other way, one liter/100 km equals **235.21458 miles/gallon (us)s**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> liter/100 kms = miles/gallon (us)s × 235.21458

Worked example — converting 10 miles/gallon (us)s:

10 × 235.21458 = **23.521458 L/100km**.

To invert, divide by 235.21458 (or multiply by 235.21458).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 mpg ≈ 235.21458 L/100km. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Miles/Gallon (US) and Liter/100 km both measure fuel consumption; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.

**Q:** How many liter/100 kms are in 1 miles/gallon (us)?
**A:** 235.21458 liter/100 kms.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert mpg to L/100km?
**A:** liter/100 kms = miles/gallon (us)s × 235.21458.

**Q:** How do I convert L/100km back to mpg?
**A:** Multiply by 235.21458 (or divide by 235.21458).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
